title: ever FAYE|Chic V Neck Asymmetrical Hem Ruffles Sleeve Pleated Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Perfect for a romantic garden wedding, this chic V neck high-low wedding guest dress is a delightful choice. The ruffled sleeves and pleated chiffon material add a touch of elegance, creating a whimsical look that's bound to impress.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
